paragraphs.text:
Clearly, none of the others expected anyone to pay such a 
ludicrous price for the crude idol. You still can’t believe how 
much money you offered for it, but the grotesque and misshapen 
thing is now yours. The monk and the men in dark suits stare 
daggers at you, but nobody else seems to mind or take much 
notice beyond a few raised eyebrows that anyone would pay such 
an excessive amount for such a trifling and outlandish thing. Still, 
when you look Amelia’s way, you can tell she is quite pleased.
